title: Porsche 993 Technical Specification Booklet, 1994-1995
notes: 68-page Carrera/Carrera RS reference. No M64.60 found in inspected text. Carrera engine mass and settings are not Turbo specifications. Read visually on 2026-11-05 (PDF SHA-256 573f48c564014f501691c17e7444800eaa146eec731f600b339b274fc86e20f2): printed page 18 (PDF page 12), 'Engine Weight (Tiptronic) kg/lbs 232 (224)' for the 911 Carrera; printed page 22 (PDF page 14) lists the transmission separately, 'Transmission Weight with Oil' 66 kg (G50/21) and 72.5 kg (G64/21, Carrera 4), and 105 kg for the Tiptronic on page 23. The 232 kg engine figure therefore excludes the gearbox. The sheet does not say whether the engine is dry or which ancillaries it includes.
